# Landrum Law LLP

> A Los Angeles-based law firm specializing in medical malpractice, professional license defense, and vaccine injury claims.

Landrum Law LLP is led by Keith Landrum, a medical malpractice and license defense attorney with extensive expertise in healthcare law and administrative proceedings. The firm serves clients across Southern California with offices in Beverly Hills and Los Angeles.
